sections.heading: Important Disclaimer
paragraphs: The ChipCraft Virtual Lab Environment is developed as part of an educational initiative under a MeitY-supported project, jointly implemented by NIELIT and SoCTeamup Semiconductors Pvt. Ltd.

This platform hosts various open-source Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools and workflows, including but not limited to Verilator, Yosys, OpenLane, Qflow, and Magic, Netgen, Klayout, OpenSTA etc. and other community-developed software. All such tools remain the intellectual property of their respective authors and contributors and are used in accordance with their applicable open-source licenses.

The virtual lab environment is provided strictly for educational, research, and skill development purposes. While reasonable efforts are made to ensure stability, correctness, and availability, the platform and associated tools are provided on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis without warranties of any kind, express or implied.
Users are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable open-source licenses when exporting, modifying, or redistributing any tool outputs or derived works.

The hosting institutions shall not be liable for any direct or indirect losses arising from use of the platform, including but not limited to design errors, data loss, service interruptions, or misuse.
Access to the platform may be modified, restricted, or withdrawn at any time in accordance with project policies and governance requirements.

sections.title: About Us
sections.tagline: A trusted national institution delivering skill development, training, and certification in electronics and information technology.

sections.heading: An Open-Source First EdTech Platform for Chip Design
paragraphs: eChipHub is a jointly developed digital initiative by NIELIT, under the aegis of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, in collaboration with SoCTeamup Semiconductors Pvt. Ltd. as the industry partner.

The platform is envisioned to strengthen India’s capabilities in chip design, SoC development, full-stack IP creation, and open-source EDA tool adoption, contributing to long-term semiconductor self-reliance and digital sovereignty.

In an era where semiconductors underpin strategic independence and technological competitiveness, eChipHub aims to make industry-grade chip design skills accessible, scalable, and affordable for students, researchers, faculty, startups, and MSMEs across the country.

Through industry led structured training programs, cloud-based virtual labs, open source design flows, and mentorship from academia and industry, eChipHub seeks to enable participants to take their designs from RTL to GDSII using complete open and hybrid design flows.

By combining public institutional support with industry expertise, eChipHub represents a collaborative model to democratize semiconductor knowledge and build a sustainable national ecosystem for innovation.

sections.heading: Our Purpose
sections.statement: To strengthen India’s digital ecosystem by developing a future-ready workforce equipped with practical skills, industry exposure, and nationally recognized certifications through quality education and training.

cards.description: Our purpose is to empower students, professionals, and institutions with relevant technical skills that align with industry demands. Through structured learning and hands-on training, we aim to support national digital growth and innovation.

sections.heading: Our Commitment
sections.statement: We are committed to delivering high-quality, transparent, and industry-relevant training programs that empower learners with practical skills. Our focus is on excellence in education while actively supporting national initiatives such as Digital India and Skill India , ensuring learners are prepared for real-world challenges.
